content: Iliya ak-d Axazya - Řmewt n Axazya
Awarni řmewt n Axab iɣewweɣ Mu’ab x Israil.
Iwḍa-dd Axazya s tracca n řkazi n tɣurfet nnes di Samarya uca ihřec. Netta issekk ireqqasen inna asen: “Ruḥem ɣar Baɛal-Zabub, arebbi n Ɛaqrun, maḥend ad tesseqsam ma war d ayi ineqq řehřac-a.”

Maca lmalak n SIDI issiweř-dd ɣar Ilicaɛ, Aticbi: “Kkar, geɛɛed, řqa ireqqasen n ujeǧid n Samarya u siweř akidsen: ‘Ma s tidett war din AREBBI di Israil, ařami kenniw tuyurem, ḥima ad tesseqsam Baɛal-Zabub, arebbi n Ɛaqrun?’
S uya, ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘War dd-thekkʷid ca zi tassut i x tgeɛɛded, maca ad temmted řmewt.’” Uca xenni iffeɣ Iliya.
Řami dd-ɛeqben ireqqasen ɣar Axaziya, inna asen i nitni: “Min ixs ad yini man aya, řami dd-tɛeqbem ɛawed deɣya?”

Nitni arrin-dd xas: “Ijj n weryaz imsagar akidneɣ, inna aneɣ: ‘Ɛeqbem ɣar ujeǧid wenni kenniw dd-issekken, ad as tinim: Ammu i issiweř SIDI, ma s tidett war ɣarwem zeɛma AREBBI di Israil ařami tessekked, ḥima ad tesseqsid Baɛal-Zabub, arebbi n Ɛaqrun? S uya war dd-thekkʷid ca zi tassut i x tgeɛɛded, maca ad temmted řmewt.’”
Netta issiweř akidsen: “Mammec igga waddud n weryaz nni kidwem imsagaren u issiweř akidwem awařen-a?”
Nitni arrin-dd xas: “Netta d ijj n weryaz ɣares ijj n upartessu n ucuwwaf, ɣares ijj n webyas n ccark x tejɛinna nnes.” Xenni inna netta: “Wa d Iliya, Aticbi.”

Netta issekk ijj n umeqqran n xemsin ak-d xemsin n yeryazen nnes ɣares. Wanita igeɛɛed ɣares, u xzar, Iliya tuɣa ittɣima x tqiccat n wedrar. U netta issiweř ɣares: “Cek, aryaz n AREBBI, ajeǧid inna ac: ‘Hwa-dd!’”

Iliya yarra-dd, inna i umeqqran n xemsin: “Mařa necc aqa d aryaz n AREBBI, ejj ad tewḍa tmessi zeg ujenna, ad cek tecc, cek d xemsin n yeryazen nnec.” Řexdenni tewḍa-dd tmessi zeg ujenna, tecca i-t netta d xemsin n yeryazen nnes.
Xas uca issekk ɣares ɛawed ijj n umeqqran nneɣni n xemsin ak-d xemsin n yeryazen nnes. Wanita iṭṭef deg wawař, inna as: “Cek, a aryaz n AREBBI, ammu i iqqar ujeǧid: ‘Hwa-dd deɣya!’”

Iliya yarra-dd uca inna asen: “Mařa necc d aryaz n AREBBI, ammu i dd ɣa tewḍa tmessi zeg ujenna, ad cek tecc d yeryazen nnec,” Řexdenni tewḍa-dd tmessi zeg ujenna, tecca i-t netta d xemsin n yeryazen nnes.

Issekk ɛawed ijj n umeqqran n xemsin i twařa wiss třata, ak-d xemsin n yeryazen nnes. Umi igeɛɛed umeqqran n xemsin wiss třata uca yiweḍ ɣares, yuḍar netta x ifadden nnes zzat i Iliya uca iḥeccem i-t, inna as: “A aryaz n AREBBI, ejj ad teswa tudart inu d tudart n imsexxaren nnec, n xemsin n yeryazen-a, di tiṭṭawin nnec.
Xzar, timessi tewḍa-dd zeg ujenna, tecca tnayen n imeqqranen n xemsin ak-d xemsin n yeryazen nsen. Ejj ad teswa řexxu tudart inu di tiṭṭawin nnec!”
Uca inna lmalak n SIDI i Iliya: “Hwa akides, war tteggʷed ca zzat i wudem nnes!” Ikkar netta, ihwa akides ɣar ujeǧid.

Xas uca issiweř ak-d ujeǧid: “Ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Maɣar cek tessekked ireqqasen nnec, ḥima ad sseqsan Baɛal-Zabul, arebbi n Ɛaqrun, axmi war din iǧi s tidett AREBBI di Israil, ḥima ad t tesseqsid x wawař nnes, s uya war dd-thekkwid ca zi tassut i x tgeɛɛded, maca ad temmted řmewt.’”
Ammu i immut ɛlaḥsab awař n SIDI i tuɣa issiweř Iliya. Maɣar netta tuɣa war ɣares bu mmis, idweř Yuram d ajeǧid deg wemcan nnes deg useggʷas wiss tnayen n Yahuram, mmis n Yahucafaṭ, ajeǧid n Yahuda.
Imezruyen iqqimen n Axazya, d min igga, ma man aya marra war ittwazemmem ca deg wedlis n imezruyen n ijeǧiden n Israil?

footnotes.text: Řami dd-ɛeqben ireqqasen ɣar Axazya- s Tɛibranit ‘Řami ɣares dd-ɛeqben ireqqasen’.
Aticbi- ijj n weryaz zi tendint n Ticbi.
